$comment: Store listing fields that apify push never sends. Applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs after every deploy. Title, description and categories live in actor.json.
seoTitle: Domain History Lookup - WHOIS History + Past Owner Contacts
seoDescription: Domain history lookup API. Find who owned a domain in the past: WHOIS history, Wayback pages, and the owner's emails, phones and names, each with a source URL and date.

pricing.$comment: PROPOSAL, not applied. Apify allows one pricing change per 30 days and the first set is the only free one, so a human flips apply to true. Start floor covers compute (measured: quick 0.10 CU, standard 0.20 CU at 2048MB); the per-row event is the contact-with-provenance the customer asked for. The summary row per domain is also a dataset item and is billed by the same event.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: One domain, any depth. Covers the archive crawl, page rendering, the entity model, registration, DNS, certificate and reference lookups, and the coverage report.

apify-default-dataset-item.eventDescription: One row per contact per source: email, phone, person or organisation, with the URL and capture date that produced it. Includes one summary row per domain.
